comments.text: Complete AI slop. I mean some of the videos are from Indonesia but they are also from all over the world, India, China, Korea etc. I am pretty sure one clip was of Iceland!

replies.author: @Dave-ns9dt
replies.text: At 4:28. It is so obviously not in Indonesia. It looked like Scandinavia to me. I just googled the image and it's a town in Iceland. The whole video is full of clips from Hong Kong or various other Asian countries etc. The bit about its amazing airports is Singapore airport. I lived in Indonesia for years. I know what it looks like

replies.author: @GlobalTravelGuide-68
replies.text: Calling the whole video “AI slop” doesn’t actually prove that the footage is fake or from different countries. Could you point out the exact clip you believe is from Iceland and explain how you identified it?
